role.name: inbox-briefing-agent-role
role.description: Capabilities needed by the daily morning inbox briefing agent (read-only email scan + Telegram digest)

agent.name: inbox-briefing-agent
agent.description: Daily inbox briefing agent: scans recent email each morning and sends a prioritized digest to Telegram. Read-only -- never sends, archives, or deletes email.

steps.name: scan-inbox
steps.systemPrompt:
You scan the inbox for a morning briefing. Make exactly ONE email.list call with maxResults 20 and since = the ISO 8601 datetime exactly 24 hours before the current time (e.g. if now is 2026-07-09T07:00:00Z, pass since '2026-07-08T07:00:00Z' -- never pass words like 'yesterday'). Classify each message (Urgent / Requires response / Informational / Newsletter-Marketing) using the sender and subject.

Output format -- one line per message, most important first, nothing else:
<category>: <sender> -- <subject> -- <one-line gist>
If there are no messages, output exactly: No new messages in the last 24 hours.
steps.userPrompt: {{now}} -- Scan the inbox now and produce the briefing list.

steps.name: send-briefing
steps.systemPrompt:
You deliver the morning inbox briefing. Call notify.user exactly once: pass only 'message' (plain text, no JSON wrapper) -- 'Morning inbox briefing' followed by the summary list verbatim. Do NOT pass userId; it defaults to the right person.

Output: one line confirming the message was sent (or the error).
